sources.details: For a,b in[-8,7],u=a+8,v=b+8 lie0..15. u and16*v have disjoint set bits, so OR=u+16v in0..255; P&15=u and P>>4=v. Subtract8 recovers a,b. Odd n appends code8 (zero), and original shape product removes it; stored payload is ceil(n/2) uint8 bytes. Example pairs give0+16*7=112,8+16*9=152,15+16*10=175,11+16*8=139; append4 changes high code12 and last byte11+16*12=203. Existing13 Linear buffers give57600+5664+2560=65824, plus102912=168736 bytes; corresponding counts115200 weight,1416 scale,640 bias,25728 retained float elements.
